verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a full Terminal API and Management API for POS (JSON-based, works over local/cloud), publishes an OpenAPI spec on GitHub, and provides webhooks, testing tools, and even an MCP server for natural-language API access, all clearly documented as public developer resources. A community post describes past integration pain with an older card-present protocol, but this doesn't contradict the current public API's existence or documentation, just adds a friction caveat. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reviews confirming ease-of-use of the current Terminal/Management API and richer live API reference examples beyond docs pages.
